name: F5-TTS (SWivid)
blurb: MIT flow-matching model: fast (near real-time warm on a 3060 Ti at low NFE), low hallucination on long text, clones from 5–15s. Auto-transcribes the reference.

models.name: F5-TTS v1 Base — best quality/speed balance

params.label: Quality steps (NFE)
params.help: ODE solver steps. 16 ≈ 2× faster and still good; 32 = reference quality.

params.label: Guidance (CFG)
params.help: How hard it follows text + reference. 2.0 default.

params.label: Speaking rate
params.help: F5's own rate control (better than post-stretch).

params.label: Seed (0 = random)
params.help: Fix a seed to reproduce a take you liked.

params.label: Pitch (semitones)
params.help: Shift the voice up/down, keeping the speaker's timbre (TD-PSOLA).

params.label: Formant / character
params.help: Vocal-tract size independent of pitch: + = younger, − = deeper.

params.label: Clarity
params.help: Speech-intelligibility EQ: less mud, more presence and air.

params.label: Loudness normalize (0/1)
params.help: Match every take to a consistent loudness (-18 LUFS).
